claims.fact: The TV shows footage of Grand Theft Auto 6 – presumably provided to South Park’s creators by Rockstar – and features a gameplay sequence where protagonist Jason is on the beach , and sees a dog owner letting their dog poo on the sand, before picking it up with a bag.
claims.quote: The TV shows footage of Grand Theft Auto 6 – presumably provided to South Park’s creators by Rockstar – and features a gameplay sequence where protagonist Jason is on the beach , and sees a dog owner letting their dog poo on the sand, before picking it up with a bag.

claims.fact: Jason throws an object at the dog owner, starting a fight, during which Jason picks up the bag of dog poo and slaps it across the man’s head.
